messages:
Maria (sec-eng): Carol asked for a quick sample: can we produce a snapshot showing RBAC change -> KMS decrypt events -> svc account token use for a week? cc @Sam @Ben

Sam (infra): Got it. Which org/roles? if you can give an example UID I can scope queries. Also need retention/legal ok for sharing logs.

Maria (sec-eng): Example: rolebinding id rb-93f2 and svc-account:ingest-worker@redwood-prod. Window: 2026-03-15 -> 2026-03-21. Auditor prefers minimal redaction, but ok with hashes. Carol, confirm.

Carol (auditor): Confirmed. Hashing for PII ok. We need: (1) k8s audit log entries for the RBAC change, (2) cloud KMS decrypt audit entries, (3) SIEM correlation that shows the svc token usage from the same IP, (4) a signed manifest describing export steps. Timestamp order matters. Thanks.

Ben (platform): For KMS entries we'll pull CloudTrail logs. For Kubernetes I'll generate an audit slice. Plan: snapshot -> upload to private S3 presigned URL -> produce manifest with SHA256 hashes and a signed GPG note. Is GPG signing okay? @Alice (oncall) FYI about potential load during export.

Alice (oncall): GPG is fine. Keep exports off primary cluster control plane during peak. Can schedule at 01:00 UTC. :clock1: 

Sam (infra): Working queries now. Splunk/SIEM query I will run:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=UpdateRoleBinding userIdentity.accountId=1234567890 earliest="2026-03-15T00:00:00Z" latest="2026-03-21T23:59:59Z"
```
I'll also capture authn logs and pod exec traces. ETA 3 hours.

Maria (sec-eng): Thanks. Also include vulnerability triage context: if the RBAC change was related to CVE-2026-3321 PR, note the PR id and the Jira. Put a short note in manifest linking to the vuln triage doc.

Sam (infra): Noted: PR #4187, JIRA INFSEC-272. Will append to manifest.

Ben (platform): After export I'll run `sha256sum` over artifacts and drop the manifest and signature in s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1768223344/
I'll share a presigned link to Carol when done.

Carol (auditor): Perfect. Also: can you include a small sample of the decrypted payload (masked) to verify key use? A single line is sufficient.

Maria (sec-eng): We should avoid sharing plaintext secrets. Provide a masked sample and the KMS key ID and retention pointer. Auditor ok? :eyes: 

Carol (auditor): Masked sample + key ID + retention pointer is acceptable. :thumbsup: 

Deploy-bot: export-job-1768223344 started by Sam at 2026-03-22T01:10:05Z

Sam (infra): Export complete. Uploaded artifacts to private S3, manifest and signature created. Presigned link sent to Carol via DM. Logs show rolebinding update at 2026-03-16T03:12:11Z, KMS decrypt at 2026-03-16T03:12:13Z, token use at 2026-03-16T03:12:20Z. I'll drop the SIEM query snippet in the DM as well.

Maria (sec-eng): Great — I'll add the control mapping note and close the loop with QA. Thanks team. :tada:
